fit_reason: Private owner selling two whole vintage aluminum boats; the photos show one hull in detail, which we can clean and polish.
findings: Grime, dirt and debris in the bottom of the hull near the bow
Dirt and debris packed under the bench seats
Weathered, faded and peeling paint on the forward deck
Dull, weathered paint along the starboard hull with dark staining at the bow
Weathered, faded red finish on the wooden bench seats
Leaves and debris tucked under the seat ends visible in the overhead shot
message: Hi Terry, we saw your listing for the pair of King Fisher boats. The bottom of the hull and the area under the seats have a lot of dirt and debris, and the outside of the hull looks weathered. We do pre-sale cleanups and come to you, and a good wash-out and clean exterior would help buyers see the boats in better condition. Would you like a quote?
